purpose: Regression fixture for distinct orchid bloom scales that were incorrectly measured as top and base arrangement spans.

top.description: Cluster of sculpted fondant orchid flowers arranged on top of the cake

base.description: Sculpted fondant orchid flowers arranged on the base board

fresh_output_invariants: each flower size_line measures one typical visible bloom, not an arrangement span
visibly separable orchid scale groups use separate edible_flowers rows
each visible flower head belongs to exactly one main_toppers or support_elements row
flower rows use individual-flower wording and never cluster, bouquet, spray, arrangement, bunch, or group as the counted noun
